page.layout: One printed page of running text, one column. Running head at top, "ACTIS. LIBER VI.", with page number 349 at top right. Text continues from the previous page. Heading "137. IOANNES uicefimus tertius." in the middle, then one further paragraph. No marginal notes. No catchword or signature.

main_text.p: ius corpus:uacauitq; sedes usq; in tertium annum. Huius temporee,[?] & eodem quo obijt anno, Henri-cus Lutzemburgus Imperator, quum Siciliæ reg-num, ad quod à Siculis uocabatur, armis iam ad se pertrahere instituieret, à pseudomonacho Bernardo de monte Politiano, Dominicastro, ex Guelpho-rum conspiratione, qui se amicum Imperatori diu simulauerat, intoxicata hostia, quam bono princi-pi dum Eucharistia fese confirmaret, dederat, per fidiose perimebatur. Pius uero princeps, cum sen-tiret uenenum sibi datum, proditorem illum mo-nachum, ut fugeret, admonuisse fertur his uerbis: Domine, recedatis. Nam si percipiunt Teutonici, & nostri deuoti, morte moriemini. Qui Senas re-cedens, aurum quod ei in mercedem impietatis e-rat promissum, accepit, scelestissimus Iudas. Sed confratres suos Dominicanos non liberauit. Nam multi eorum in Thuscia, Lombardia, & aliis lo-cis, una cum domibus, igne, gladi oue[?] perierunt.
main_text.head: 137. IOANNES uicefimus tertius.
main_text.p: Ioannes uicefimus tertius, natione Gallus, patre Arnoldo de Offa, Iacobus Caturcensis antea nominatus, Cardinalis episcopus Portuensis, post biennij spacium, quo sedes ob 23. Cardinalium al-tercationes vacasset, Lugduni Papa renunciaba-tur.

page.notes: Top of page: the first line is a fragment continuing from the previous page. Margins are clear, with no marginal notes. Uncertain readings: "temporee," (possibly "temporis,"), "gladi oue" (possibly "gladio uel"), and the hyphen after "Henri-" and "reg-" which is faint in the scan. The printed hyphen after "Henria" is not clearly visible and has been supplied. Printing forms such as "obijt" and "ob 23." are left as printed.
